# Data Integrity Requirements Checklist

**Purpose**: Validate SPEC-009C3 data-integrity requirements before task generation
**Created**: 2026-05-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements defined for keeping `mission-control_dev_implementation` as the sole PR owner and `ready_for_owner` subject? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003, §SC-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for rejecting C3 success when `github_repo` or `github_pr_number` is missing from the PR-producing dev task? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-010b]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for all required stage artifacts before readiness evaluation: remediation plan, dev verification, review verdict, Aegis approval, and governance evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §FR-010a, §FR-011, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK004 Are data-integrity requirements defined for review `fix` and Aegis `rejected` paths blocking Aegis/owner readiness while retaining evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK005 Are activity evidence rows explicitly required to preserve the same workspace scope as the PR-producing dev task and related artifacts/reviews? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010c, Plan §Technical Context]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is root issue traceability separated clearly from dev-task PR ownership? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-001, Contract §Readiness Subject]
- [x] CHK007 Are artifact envelope fields specific enough to validate root issue identity, dev-task PR identity, workspace identity, schema version, storage kind, and MIME type? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010a, §FR-010b, Contract §Common Artifact Envelope]
- [x] CHK008 Are allowed review verdict and Aegis status vocabularies closed and mapped to the existing `quality_reviews` vocabulary? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005, §FR-007, Contract §Review Verdict, §Aegis Approval]
- [x] CHK009 Is fixture PR identity clearly distinguished from live GitHub proof? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, §FR-014, §SC-006, Quickstart §Fixture Validation Path]

## Idempotency And Duplicate Retry Coverage

- [x] CHK010 Are repeated review/Aegis retry requirements defined so stale successors are not duplicated and prior verdict/rejection evidence is not overwritten? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-006, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK011 Are failure and retry requirements consistent with the existing one-successor/idempotent retry contract rather than adding a new claim or run-state authority? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §FR-017, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK012 Can duplicate retry behavior be objectively verified from task lineage, successor rows, artifacts, reviews, and activity evidence? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001..§SC-005, Data Model §State Transitions]

## Workspace Scope And Referential Integrity

- [x] CHK013 Are tasks, stage artifacts, and Aegis quality-review rows required to use the same workspace as the readiness subject? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-010a, §FR-010b, Data Model §Aegis Quality Review]
- [x] CHK014 Are wrong-workspace Aegis rows, missing canonical quality-review rows, and unsupported verdict values fail-closed readiness conditions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, §FR-010b, Data Model §Fail-Closed Conditions]
- [x] CHK015 Are governance blockers defined as readiness-blocking without creating durable governance/claim/run-state authority in this slice? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §FR-012, Contract §Governance Evidence]
- [x] CHK016 Are out-of-scope data mutations explicitly excluded: merge observation, merge reconciliation, `done` reconciliation, automatic PR polling, and broad workflow slug migration? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017, Contract §Out-of-Scope Assertions]

## Evidence Safety

- [x] CHK017 Are artifact payload data minimization requirements defined to exclude secrets, tokens, credentials, connection strings, and raw sensitive logs/source? [Security, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §Stage Artifact]
- [x] CHK018 Are deterministic fixture validation and optional live draft PR smoke separated enough to prevent accidental external GitHub mutation during automated tests? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-014, Quickstart §Optional Live Draft PR Smoke]

## Notes

- CHK005 was resolved by adding FR-010c and plan technical-context wording requiring SPEC-009C3 review, Aegis, governance, retry, and readiness activity evidence to preserve the PR-producing dev task workspace scope.
